scenes.headline: How a transformer learns to predict its own state
scenes.sub: NextLat: one extra loss, one stop-gradient, one small MLP.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Jasmine! NextLat trains a transformer so its hidden state summarizes the past, like a recurrent network's must. Here's how.

scenes.text: Alongside next-token prediction, train the transformer's hidden state to predict its own next value, from the current state plus the real next token.
scenes.say: The idea: besides the next token, the hidden state must predict its own next value, from the current state and the real next token.

left.title: A plain transformer
items: Attention can look up any past token
Its memory grows with the sequence
Rewarded for reading, not for summarizing
left.say: A recurrent network must squeeze its past into one fixed state. A transformer needn't: attention looks up any past token.

right.title: Add next-latent prediction
items: The state must predict its own future
So it keeps what still matters
right.say: NextLat adds that pressure back, without touching the architecture.

steps.say: The transformer reads the tokens so far. Its final hidden state feeds the usual next-token loss.
Now a small MLP takes that hidden state, plus the real next token, not a sampled one.
It predicts the next hidden state.

steps.note: sg: the target is not moved by this loss
steps.say: The guess is graded against the transformer's actual next state, behind a stop-gradient, so the real state can't drift to meet a lazy guess.

steps.note: the MLP never runs at inference
steps.say: The MLP can chain several steps ahead, each fed the real token. After training it's thrown away.

scenes.title: One loss, three terms
scenes.text: L = L_token + λ_h L_next-h + λ_KL L_KL
scenes.say: The loss is a weighted sum of three terms.

parts.note: Smooth L1 between predicted and actual next states
parts.say: A Smooth L1 distance between predicted and actual next states.

parts.note: both states must decode to the same tokens
parts.say: And a KL term: the predicted state must decode to the same token distribution as the real one.

scenes.title: Sequence compression, Manhattan taxi rides
scenes.note: two routes to one corner, identical continuations
scenes.say: The sharpest probe: two routes reach the same corner. Do they continue identically? NextLat, seventy-one percent. GPT, sixty-five. All in small models.

scenes.text: Grade a hidden state on predicting its own future, and it is pushed toward a compact summary of the history.

recap: A small MLP predicts the next hidden state
A stop-gradient keeps the target honest
Thrown away at inference: 57M parameters, like GPT
scenes.say: To recap: predict your own next state, stop the gradient on the target, and discard the helper after training.
